The main takeaway from our work is that

a 90 degree dielectric-loaded waveguide (DLWG) junction can be used to couple 90 degrees of power to a 0.14-THz waveguide with an insertion loss of less than 0.5-mm, which is the minimum required length for the 90 degrees of phase shift.
the 90deg coupling scheme is a feasible way to realize the THz beam steering, which can be applied to THz imaging system.
